Configuration._comment: Hardening allowlist for code-loading config (PickingPostProcessing). Format: 'AssemblyFileName|FullTypeName'. When non-empty it is ENFORCED: only listed assembly/type pairs may be loaded or saved via the config API. Leave empty to permit any (a warning is logged).

ConnectionStrings._ReportingConnection_1_what: OPTIONAL, OFF BY DEFAULT. Used ONLY to execute admin-authored SQL reports against SAP's database. Left blank (as shipped) it falls back to ExternalAdapterConnection, so reports work out of the box — but they then run with whatever rights that login has, which in this template is sa.
ConnectionStrings._ReportingConnection_2_why: Report SQL is written by superusers at runtime, so a destructive typo is a real risk on a live SAP database. A read-only login is the ONLY control that actually stops one. The always-rollback transaction, the SELECT/WITH-only check and the single-statement check are defence in depth around it, not substitutes for it.
ConnectionStrings._ReportingConnection_3_enable: To enable at a customer: run the SQL below against SAP's database, then paste the connection string from _4_sample into ReportingConnection and restart the service. No other change is needed.
ConnectionStrings._ReportingConnection_4_sql: CREATE LOGIN wms_reports_ro WITH PASSWORD = '<strong-password>'; USE [<SAP_DB_NAME>]; CREATE USER wms_reports_ro FOR LOGIN wms_reports_ro; ALTER ROLE db_datareader ADD MEMBER wms_reports_ro; DENY INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, EXECUTE TO wms_reports_ro;
